question: Does the fixed32 ordinary successor-success predictor meet the unchanged repeat-forecast precision requirement on freshly generated acquisition blocks?

writer.kind: native exact full rewrite from final body

acquisition.teaching: E016 consistent regime: positive cue and coordinated negative cue use the same base draws with opposite polarity; four paired opposite-rule founders, four recipients. Fresh namespace in every teaching, injury and renewal stream.
acquisition.boundary: g14 outgoing packet and eleven TT008 features. Matched acquisition noise; original writer except four declared historical schedules. Causally discarded holding steps remain omitted as in prior verified replay.
acquisition.audit: Separate flat teaching replay for every block; four-history flat-reader and writer checks at g1,g3,g14 for founder0/recipient0; sparse independent transfer for every g14 record. Benchmark reconstructs exposed block34000 and requires exact archived four-history g14 packets and expression.

selection.rule: Generate all16 blocks and all64 g14 records/block before probing. Within each block/current-expression stratum select the first SHA256-ranked record of each task rule if both exist; otherwise first two available. If fewer than two exist retain available records. No replacement blocks or outcome-based extension.
selection.inputs: Only key,current-expression class,task rule; no forecasts,probe results or future outcomes.
selection.rationale: Bounded feasibility replication with twice the previous number of acquisition blocks and up to32 records/class. Coverage minima prevent advancement from a depleted failure class; operational coverage, not a power calculation.

forcing.seed: First16 SHA256 bytes of compact JSON [namespace,stage,*record_key,probe,purpose,channel], little endian, PCG64.
forcing.coupling: Regimes share base draws and injuries. Matched copies first cue birth/noise to second; independent retains both. Writer/evaluation use distinct purpose keys; unchanged and rewritten evaluations share B.
forcing.injury: 24 distinct uniformly selected non-port cells/read; all three2x2 ports protected.

models.candidate: Frozen all512 rewrite_32 ridge-logistic model: eleven TT008 features plus qRewrite32.
models.comparator: Frozen all512 retained_8 model chosen by previous full-development rule.
models.boundary_reference: Frozen all512 TT008. Repeat difference is structurally zero because B is fixed; this is not forecast accuracy evidence.
models.fitting: No coefficient,scaling,feature,budget,threshold or rival selection on fresh data. No fitting.
models.source_limit: Original PORTABLE_MODELS development_gate_pass=false retained byte-for-byte. New fixed-budget attempt cannot reverse failed nested selector.

measurement.audit: Each record/regime/repeat: first writer independently evolved with flat reader, then its own successor and original evaluated under B; bodies,windows,outgoing must agree byte-for-byte.
measurement.evidence: Retain original packet,writer/successor arrays for64 probes/regime,direct arrays for16 probes,masks,births,windows,ends,outgoing,forcing hashes,predictions. Evaluation writes discarded causally.

endpoint.name: Absolute difference between two forecasts from independent32-probe repeats with fixed B.
endpoint.primary: Empirical linear-interpolated p90 separately by current-expression stratum and noise regime; also maximum and exceedance counts.
endpoint.uncertainty: Descriptive95% acquisition-block percentile bootstrap,5000 resamples preserving relatives,repeats,regimes. Not a population assurance bound.
endpoint.coverage: Both strata require >=24 selected records across >=12 of16 fixed blocks.
endpoint.pass_rule: FRESH_PRECISION_SCREEN_PASS only if coverage,all four candidate p90<=.10,frozen inputs and independent evidence audit pass.
endpoint.fail_rule: Any p90>.10: FRESH_PRECISION_SCREEN_FAILED. Coverage shortfall: FRESH_PRECISION_COVERAGE_INSUFFICIENT. Numerical/evidence failure: execution FAILED, no scientific verdict.
endpoint.comparator: Report both comparators; candidate need not be more repeatable, since precision does not establish useful prediction.
endpoint.continuation: A pass permits pricing a separately frozen fresh-outcome test. No g15..32 futures,Brier,calibration,automatic successor,budget increase or replacement seeds.

candidate_test_box.prediction: p90 absolute repeat-forecast difference<=.10 in both strata and regimes.
candidate_test_box.held_out_change: 16 new acquisition blocks,disjoint namespace,fixed coefficients; matched/independent measurement noise; acquisition remains matched.
candidate_test_box.comparator: Frozen retained8 at8 reads/repeat and TT008; candidate64 reads/repeat.
candidate_test_box.rejection: Any precision group>.10; inadequate coverage yields insufficient evidence; no long-horizon claim.

resources.benchmark: Full native acquisition/legacy alignment and two-regime64-probe synthetic measurement. Forecast1.5*(16*acquisition_seconds+64*two_regime_measurement_seconds)+300 including audit,persistence; must fit10h.

limits: Fixed32 was chosen from exposed development; this tests fresh repeatability of an outcome-informed choice.
No RDT novelty,calibration,long-horizon advantage or population failure frequency.
Balanced selected strata are not population proportions.
Previous failed RDT models and nested selector retain their verdicts.
